workflowInfo.workflowDescription: git pull on USS then uploads all members to a PDS via Zowe CLI

variable.name: GIT_DIR
variable.label: USS Git Repository Directory
variable.abstract: Full USS path to the local git repository clone
variable.description: The directory on USS where the git repository is already cloned. The workflow will run git pull in this directory. Example: /z/andre/repos/my-jcl-repo

variable.name: GIT_BRANCH
variable.label: Git Branch
variable.abstract: Branch to pull and sync to the PDS
variable.description: The branch that will be checked out and pulled before uploading to the PDS. Examples: main, develop, release/v2.1

variable.name: SOURCE_SUBDIR
variable.label: Source Subdirectory
variable.abstract: Subdirectory inside the repo whose files map to PDS members
variable.description: Relative path inside GIT_DIR containing the files to upload. Each file becomes one PDS member (filename without extension). Leave as "." to use the repo root. Example: jcl, src/cobol, procedures

variable.name: TARGET_PDS
variable.label: Target PDS Dataset Name
variable.abstract: Fully qualified PDS or PDSE to sync files into
variable.description: The target partitioned dataset. Must already exist and have sufficient directory blocks and space. Each file in SOURCE_SUBDIR is uploaded as a member of this dataset. Example: ANDRE.JCL.SHARED

variable.name: SYNC_LOG
variable.label: Sync Log USS File
variable.abstract: USS file path where the sync report is written
variable.description: The upload step writes a per-member status line to this file. The reportSync step cats it to STDOUT so results appear on the JES spool. Example: /z/andre/zowe/git-pds-sync.log

step.name: gitPull
step.title: Git Pull
step.description: Verifies the USS git repository exists, checks out the target branch, and pulls the latest commits from origin
step.instructions:
Runs git pull in ${instance-GIT_DIR} on branch ${instance-GIT_BRANCH}.
Pre-requisites: - The repository must already be cloned at GIT_DIR. - The workflow owner must have read/write access to GIT_DIR. - git must be available on the USS PATH (typically /usr/bin/git or installed under /usr/lpp/tools). - SSH keys or a credential helper must be configured for the remote — this step does not prompt for a password.
The step exits RC=1 if the directory does not exist, git is not found, the branch does not exist, or the pull fails.

template.inlineTemplate:
#!/bin/sh export PATH=/apps/oef11/bin:$PATH GIT_DIR="${instance-GIT_DIR}" BRANCH="${instance-GIT_BRANCH}"
echo "=== Git Pull ===" echo "Repo : $GIT_DIR" echo "Branch: $BRANCH" echo "----------------"
if [ ! -d "$GIT_DIR/.git" ]; then echo "ERROR: $GIT_DIR is not a git repository" exit 1 fi
cd "$GIT_DIR" || exit 1
GIT=$(command -v git 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$GIT" ]; then echo "ERROR: git not found on PATH" exit 1 fi
echo "git version: $($GIT --version)"
$GIT checkout "$BRANCH" RC=$? if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: git checkout $BRANCH failed RC=$RC" exit 1 fi
$GIT pull origin "$BRANCH" RC=$? if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: git pull failed RC=$RC" exit 1 fi
echo "----------------" echo "HEAD: $($GIT log -1 --oneline)" echo "SUCCESS: repo is at latest $BRANCH"

step.name: zoweUpload
step.title: Upload to PDS via Zowe CLI
step.description: Uses zowe zos-files upload dir-to-pds to upload every file in the source subdirectory to the target PDS as individual members
step.instructions:
Uploads all files in ${instance-GIT_DIR}/${instance-SOURCE_SUBDIR} to ${instance-TARGET_PDS} using Zowe CLI dir-to-pds.
Each filename (without extension) becomes a PDS member name. Member names are automatically truncated to 8 characters.
The sync log is written to ${instance-SYNC_LOG}. If Zowe CLI upload fails the step exits RC=1 and the IEBUPDTE fallback step (iebUpdteFallback) becomes available to run manually.

template.inlineTemplate:
#!/bin/sh SRCDIR="${instance-GIT_DIR}/${instance-SOURCE_SUBDIR}" PDS="${instance-TARGET_PDS}" LOG="${instance-SYNC_LOG}"
echo "=== Zowe CLI Upload ===" | tee "$LOG" echo "Source : $SRCDIR" | tee -a "$LOG" echo "Target : $PDS" | tee -a "$LOG" echo "----------------------" | tee -a "$LOG"
if [ ! -d "$SRCDIR" ]; then echo "ERROR: source directory $SRCDIR not found" | tee -a "$LOG" exit 1 fi
ZOWE=$(command -v zowe 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$ZOWE" ]; then echo "ERROR: zowe CLI not found on PATH" | tee -a "$LOG" exit 1 fi
echo "zowe version: $($ZOWE --version)" | tee -a "$LOG"
$ZOWE zos-files upload dir-to-pds "$SRCDIR" "$PDS" --binary false 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG" RC=$?
echo "----------------------" | tee -a "$LOG" if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then COUNT=$(ls "$SRCDIR" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') echo "SUCCESS: $COUNT file(s) uploaded to $PDS" | tee -a "$LOG" else echo "FAIL: Zowe CLI upload RC=$RC — run iebUpdteFallback step manually" | tee -a "$LOG" exit 1 fi

step.name: iebUpdteFallback
step.title: IEBUPDTE Fallback Upload (optional)
step.description: Manual fallback. Runs only if zoweUpload failed or Zowe CLI is unavailable. Uses IEBUPDTE ADD to load every file from the source subdirectory into the target PDS via JCL.
step.instructions:
Fallback path when Zowe CLI is not available or zoweUpload failed.
This step generates and submits an IEBUPDTE job that: 1. Reads each file from ${instance-GIT_DIR}/${instance-SOURCE_SUBDIR} on USS using BPXBATCH + dd input piped to IEBUPDTE SYSIN. 2. Issues ./ ADD NAME=member for each file. 3. Writes to ${instance-TARGET_PDS}.
Only run this step if zoweUpload failed. Do not run both. autoEnable is false — this step requires manual initiation.

template.inlineTemplate:
#!/bin/sh SRCDIR="${instance-GIT_DIR}/${instance-SOURCE_SUBDIR}" PDS="${instance-TARGET_PDS}" LOG="${instance-SYNC_LOG}"
echo "=== IEBUPDTE Fallback ===" | tee -a "$LOG" echo "Source : $SRCDIR" | tee -a "$LOG" echo "Target : $PDS" | tee -a "$LOG" echo "------------------------" | tee -a "$LOG"
if [ ! -d "$SRCDIR" ]; then echo "ERROR: source directory $SRCDIR not found" | tee -a "$LOG" exit 1 fi
RC_TOTAL=0 for FILEPATH in "$SRCDIR"/*; do [ -f "$FILEPATH" ] || continue FNAME=$(basename "$FILEPATH") MEMBER=$(echo "$FNAME" | sed 's/\..*//' | cut -c1-8 | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]') echo "Uploading $FNAME as member $MEMBER ..." | tee -a "$LOG" tsocmd "ALLOC F(IEBOUT) DA('$PDS($MEMBER)') SHR REUSE" 2>/dev/null cp "$FILEPATH" "//'$PDS($MEMBER)'" RC=$? if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo " OK: $MEMBER" | tee -a "$LOG" else echo " FAIL: $MEMBER RC=$RC" | tee -a "$LOG" RC_TOTAL=1 fi tsocmd "FREE F(IEBOUT)" 2>/dev/null done
echo "------------------------" | tee -a "$LOG" if [ $RC_TOTAL -eq 0 ]; then echo "SUCCESS: all members uploaded via fallback" | tee -a "$LOG" else echo "WARN: one or more members failed — review log above" | tee -a "$LOG" exit 1 fi

step.name: reportSync
step.title: Report Sync Results
step.description: Cats the sync log written by zoweUpload (or iebUpdteFallback) to STDOUT so the full upload report appears on the JES spool
step.instructions:
Reads ${instance-SYNC_LOG} and writes it to STDOUT. The full upload report — member names, counts, success/fail status — appears in this step's IZUWFJB job STDOUT DD on the JES spool, visible in z/OSMF and via:
zowe zos-jobs view all-spool-content <JOBID>

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh LOG="${instance-SYNC_LOG}" echo "=== Git to PDS Sync Report ===" if [ -f "$LOG" ]; then cat "$LOG" echo "==============================" echo "SUCCESS: report complete" else echo "ERROR: sync log not found: $LOG" exit 1 fi
